proposed statement: The client wants to automate vaccination reminders by sending links to book appointments instead of manually calling clients
key statement: Vaccination-due reminders go out automatically, from the due dates VetDesk holds, with a link to book. This replaces the monthly printed list and phone calls.

proposed statement: The client has a high volume of appointments, approximately one hundred and sixty per day across three clinics, which doubles during vaccination seasons
key statement: About 160 appointments a day across the three clinics on a normal day (corrected from the first estimate of 120: Olievenhoutbosch now has a full Saturday morning and Centurion two vets).

proposed statement: The client prefers that owners choose a specific clinic when booking appointments
key statement: Owners can choose a specific vet, but don't have to.

proposed statement: The client is concerned that clients may not accept a deposit for Saturday appointments, as it could be seen as a barrier to booking
key statement: The consultant proposed taking a R100 deposit for online Saturday bookings, refunded on arrival, to cut no-shows.

proposed statement: The online booking system must only show bookings and reminders, not medical history
key statement: Owners will not see their pet's medical history or clinical notes online; the project is bookings and reminders only.
